name: The Sankofa Experience
org: University of California Office of the President, listed on the UC Riverside summer programs page
what_you_do: A free week living on a UC campus the summer before senior year. You go to workshops on college and applying to UC, meet mentors and build leadership skills. It highlights the Black student experience at UC and is open to all.
who_can_apply: Rising seniors registered at a California high school for the next school year, with at least a 3.0 GPA. Juniors graduating a year early with the senior class may apply. You must attend the whole week and a virtual orientation in early July.
pay_detail: Free for students who are chosen. You arrange your own travel to the campus. Limited travel money may be available based on need.
duration: 6 days, living on campus (Aug 2 to 7 in 2026, at UC Irvine)
deadline_text: The 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle, the priority deadline was May 15, 2026 and the final deadline was June 1, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the UC Riverside summer programs form. Apply by the first deadline to hear back by early June.
notes: In 2026 the program ran at UC Irvine, not UC Riverside, so the 2027 campus may change. No college credit, and it does not promise UC admission. Students stay in supervised dorm rooms with roommates. No remote option and no partial attendance. Questions: oep@ucop.edu.
